verdict: The Luxury Pro is the previous-generation Scooper with a smaller drawer and one fewer safety layer, and it sells for around $70 less. It is a sensible pick for a one- or two-cat household that wants a full-size globe box without paying premium prices, and it is often the cheapest way into a genuinely capable smart box.
pros: Same app as the more expensive CATLINK models
cons: Smaller drawer than the Pro X
scoreNote: Scores are research-based: compiled from manufacturer specifications, retail listings, teardown coverage and a structured read of long-run owner reports. They will be replaced with hands-on measurements when this unit enters the test queue.

sections.setup: Identical process to the Scooper Pro X and about the same twenty-five minutes. The drum is slightly lighter, which makes the initial fit easier for one person.
sections.app: The same CATLINK app as the more expensive models, with no meaningful features removed. That is unusual — most brands cut app features on the cheaper tier.
sections.odorControl: A sealed drawer and carbon filter without the active deodoriser module. Adequate for one cat, borderline for two by the end of a week. This is the clearest place where the $70 saving shows.
sections.noise: Around 50 dB at three feet. Comparable to the Litter-Robot 3 and clearly louder than the premium tier.
sections.cleaning: The same drum mechanism as the Pro X with a 9 L drawer instead of 11 L. Clay and tofu both work well. Expect to empty roughly a third more often than the Pro X in a two-cat home.
sections.safety: Infrared entry and a weight sensor, without the anti-pinch reverse. That is the one specification we would want improved, and it is the reason the safety score sits at 8.0 rather than 8.5.
sections.consumables: Standard kitchen bags and filters, around $75 a year. No proprietary anything.
sections.longTermCost: The cheapest full-size globe box with a mature app. Over five years it is several hundred dollars below the Litter-Robot 4 and still ahead of the budget tier on capability.
